nodes.notes: Acknowledges each button once, before API calls. An expired callback must not block processing.

nodes.name: Route request
nodes.notes: Each update takes exactly one route. The named parser reference preserves context after Telegram acknowledgment.

parameters.text:
⚽ Football

Which league would you like to follow?

parameters.query: SELECT $1::text AS chat_id, COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sport', f.sport, 'team_key', f.team_key, 'label', f.label) ORDER BY f.sport, f.label), '[]'::jsonb) AS prefs FROM sports_radar.follows AS f WHERE f.chat_id = $1::text;

nodes.name: Confirm follow
nodes.notes: Shared confirmation after saving or removing a follow. Escapes database labels for Telegram HTML.

nodes.name: Send my follows
nodes.notes: Five native button fields shared by My follows and the Unfollow selector. The formatter supplies labels and callbacks.

workflowId.cachedResultName: 02 Sports Radar - Build and send briefing

buttons.text: ={{ $('Understand command').first().json.reply.startsWith('Welcome to Sports Radar') ? '📅 Upcoming events' : '🏠 Home' }}

parameters.query:
WITH removed AS (
  DELETE FROM sports_radar.follows
  WHERE chat_id = $1::text AND sport = $2::text AND team_key = $3::text
  RETURNING label
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'chat_id', $1::text,
  'reply', CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM removed)
    THEN '✅ You’ve stopped following ' || (SELECT label FROM removed) || '.'
    ELSE 'You’re no longer following that selection.'
  END || E'\n\nTap My follows to see your updated list.'
) AS context;

nodes.name: Remove follow
nodes.notes: Deletes only the selected follow belonging to this private chat. Returns a confirmation even for an old/already removed button.

nodes.name: Claim Telegram update
nodes.notes: An update ID is claimed once before any side effects. A fresh user command has a new ID and is processed normally. Failed commands can be sent again as a fresh message.
